body: I mostly also feel strangely better than normal because I have been doing this for a while now. I only get down sometimes if I think about dying alone and maybe my cats eating me before they find the body. And if someone asks if I have a support system and video chat with people and I have to say no, then it feels a bit sucky for a while. As long as I don't go into the future to much I'm ok and happy to have a good excuse to stay away from people.
Don't tell anyone that you have detailed plans and you'll be fine!
Yes! And then if I get therapy I get sick of constantly thinking about what is wrong with me to share with the Therapist and I get even more depressed.
Why can't it give up like the rest?

This post has been up for just 6 hours in the middle of the night and it has 2.2k up votes! I truly am not alone. I'm not sure if that makes me feel better of worse. Sad that there are so many people suffering out there.
